## Problem

What's the problem this feature would solve? Be concrete; "it would be nice if" is hard to act on, "the current script can't handle X because Y" is easy.

## Proposed solution

What you have in mind. CLI flag, config option, new script, new doc, etc.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is your proposal better?

## Out of scope check

Please confirm this isn't on the explicitly-out-of-scope list:

- [ ] Not telemetry, analytics, or remote calls
- [ ] Not auto-fixing of regressions (the skill surfaces, humans decide)
- [ ] Not configuration sprawl (one new flag with a clear use case is fine; a config file is suspicious)
- [ ] Not adding dependencies beyond `playwright`, `pixelmatch`, `pngjs`

If your proposal is one of the above, please explain why it's an exception.

## Stack examples

If this is a request for a new stack example under `examples/`, please claim it before implementing (so two people don't build the same one). Comment on this issue saying "I'll take this" before opening a PR.
